input: Learn to make fresh pasta from scratch

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Make Fresh Pasta From Scratch
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to make fresh pasta from scratch, covering the ingredients, techniques, and tools needed.

questions.title: Which pasta shape are you most wanting to learn first?
questions.description: Identify the target pasta shape (e.g. tagliatelle, fettuccine, ravioli, pappardelle) to focus the plan.

questions.title: What is your current cooking experience level overall?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a beginner, home cook, or more advanced, to calibrate the complexity of guidance.

questions.title: Do you own a pasta machine or plan to roll by hand?
questions.description: Determine what equipment the user has or is willing to acquire, since technique differs significantly between the two.

questions.title: Is this for a specific occasion or just general skill-building?
questions.description: Find out if there is a deadline or event driving the learning, which affects how urgent and structured the plan needs to be.

questions.title: Do you have any dietary restrictions affecting the pasta dough?
questions.description: Check for requirements such as gluten-free, egg-free, or vegan dough, which would change the recipe and technique entirely.

questions.title: How many people do you typically plan to cook pasta for?
questions.description: Establish the usual serving size so that recipe quantities and batch-making advice can be tailored accordingly.

questions.title: Do you want to learn a sauce to pair with the pasta?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants the plan to cover only the pasta dough and shaping, or also a complementary sauce.
